ItemTemplateBriefDto.description: Item template: id, localized texts and icons. Every field but `id` is `null` while the template has no display data.

icon.description: Icon asset name, lowercase, without extension (`weapon_bow_i00`); a stable key for caching or overriding the image

iconPanel.description: Asset name of the panel icon, in the same form as `icon`

iconPanelUrl.description: `iconPanel` as a URL, like `iconUrl`; `null` exactly when `iconPanel` is

iconUrl.description: `icon` as a `.webp` URL on the static host of the key's tenant; `null` exactly when `icon` is

LocalizedText.description: Locale code -> text map. Supported keys: `ru`, `en`, `uk`, `es`; any of them may be absent on a given row.

platformApiKey.description: API key of the tenant, sent as `Authorization: Bearer nx_api_...`. The key determines the tenant; the scopes granted to it determine which operations it may call.

info.description:
Item-template catalog of the game servers of your tenant (your project on the L2NX platform), for third-party integrations.

Authenticate every request with an API key of the tenant sent as `Authorization: Bearer nx_api_...`; the key needs the scope `gamedata.item-templates:read`. The tenant is the one the key belongs to: do not send a `Tenant-Slug` header yourself. Send `Server-Slug` (the game-server slug) on every call. Item templates hidden on the wiki are never returned. How to get a key, and the error codes: [Authentication](https://l2nx.dev/api/authentication/).
info.title: nx-gamedata — Integration API

get.description:
Paginated catalog of visible item templates of the game server named by `Server-Slug`.

**Filters:**
- `search` — Matches the numeric item-template id (exact, when the term parses as an int) or a case-insensitive substring of the localized name (ru/en/uk). From 1 character; blank is ignored.
- `id` — Exact item-template id, repeatable. Max 200 per request.

**Sort:** `id`; default `id,ASC`

parameters.description: Matches the numeric item-template id (exact, when the term parses as an int) or a case-insensitive substring of the localized name (ru/en/uk). From 1 character; blank is ignored.
parameters.name: search

parameters.description: Exact item-template id, repeatable. Max 200 per request.
parameters.name: id

parameters.description: Sort order: `property,asc` or `property,desc`; repeat the parameter to sort by several properties
parameters.name: sort

parameters.description: Game server slug: the server this operation works on
parameters.name: Server-Slug

400.description:
More than 200 ids, or `sort` by a property other than `id`

The `Server-Slug` header is missing (`SERVER_SLUG_REQUIRED`)

401.description: No `Authorization: Bearer` header, a malformed key or an unknown key

403.description: The key is not allowed here; `code` is `API_KEY_REVOKED`, `API_KEY_EXPIRED`, `TENANT_SUSPENDED`, `TENANT_CLOSED` (on a shared host; on a tenant host a suspended or closed tenant gets `404 TENANT_NOT_FOUND`), `API_KEY_TENANT_MISMATCH` (a key of another tenant than the host) or `INSUFFICIENT_SCOPE`

404.description:
On a tenant host: the tenant is unknown, suspended or closed (`TENANT_NOT_FOUND`)

Unknown or hidden game server (`SERVER_NOT_FOUND`)

429.description: Too many requests with this key to this operation (`RATE_LIMITED`); limits: https://l2nx.dev/api/overview/#rate-limits
